message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a light blue-grey background with a red vertical border on the left. At the top, black text reads "RESTRUKTURISASI BUMN GAYA DAHLAN," "TOMY DAN PERANG BUBAT E-KTP," and "KOMUNITAS INDIA DI NUSANTARA." Below this, the large white word "TEMPO" spans the width. Smaller text underneath says "EDISI 27 AGUSTUS-2 SEPTEMBER 2012."

The central headline in bold black capital letters reads "MIMPI EMAS DI GUNUNG PADANG," followed by a subheadline: "Usia 'piramida' ini diperkirakan lebih tua dari yang ada di Mesir. Sejumlah arkeolog dan vulkanolog masih meragukannya."

In the lower half, a rectangular block of layered earth sits on a white ceramic plate. The block resembles a slice of cake with a square cross-section. Its top surface is covered in green grass with a single dark, weathered wooden post protruding vertically. The sides reveal distinct strata: reddish-brown topsoil with dark inclusions, a greyish-blue layer, and tan-colored sandy layers at the base. Fine dark crumbs rest on the plate beside the block.

A barcode and pricing information are located in the bottom left corner. Transcribed text includes "RP 29.700," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and "ISSN: 0126-4273."
